THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE  109

[Photograph: Interior page of San Jacinto Day program. Text reads:]

Programme.

———

Music.  Violin and Piano Selection,
Maura Pickens and Mrs. H. G. Evans.

Address of Welcome.  J. W. West, Miller, Grayson College.

Commencement.  Texas.

Guest.  J. B. Wood, Savoy College,
Savoy, Texas.

DISCUSSION—

Question:  Resolved that the negro should be colonized in Africa.
In favor of, yes; he is in his place.

AFFIRMATIVE.

J. K. Thompson . . . . . Kerrville, Texas.
J. C. Wells. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Paris, Texas.

NEGATIVE.

Music.  Maura Pickens and Mrs. H. G. Evans.

From Houston Society.  [illegible]

E. V. WILLIAMSON, President.
JAS. G. GRAVES, Secretary.
notes: Printed page 109. This page is a photograph/scan of the interior programme page for the San Jacinto Day celebration. Some text is partially illegible due to image quality.
